tools.name: search_courses
tools.description: Every published course, in catalogue order, or those matching a search (part of a name or a topic, e.g. "27001", "AI", "pentest"). Short records: slug, title, summary, level, format, duration, price, certificates, next date, url. Call get_course with the slug for anything specific.

tools.name: get_course
tools.description: One course in full: who it is for, learning outcomes, agenda by day, what is included, exam, prerequisites, trainers, FAQ, price, upcoming dates and the registration url. Call it as soon as someone asks anything about a specific course.

tools.name: list_events
tools.description: Upcoming training dates sorted by date: course, start and end (Belgrade time), format, location or online, seats left, price, language and the registration url. courseSlug narrows to one course.

tools.name: list_certificates
tools.description: The ICO certificates: name, kind (exam or role), issuer, description, the course slugs that lead to each, url.

tools.name: list_trainers
tools.description: The trainers: name, title, short bio, the courses each teaches, url.

tools.name: list_topics
tools.description: The subject areas the courses are grouped in: slug, name, subtitle, description, url.

tools.name: get_pricing_tiers
tools.description: The pricing bundles: name, description, price per seat in a public cohort and per private team session (EUR, omitted when on request), included features, url.

tools.name: list_pages
tools.description: The published company pages (about, FAQ, contact, terms and the like): slug, title, excerpt, url. Call get_page with the slug for the text.

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: One company page as plain text, by slug from list_pages.

tools.name: list_blog_posts
tools.description: The newest blog articles and short videos on AI governance and ISO standards: slug, title, description, date, language, author, topic, tags, url. A post is returned in the requested language when written in it, else in its own.

tools.name: get_blog_post
tools.description: One blog post as plain text, by slug from list_blog_posts, with its FAQ and related course slugs.

tools.name: create_lead
tools.description: Sends the academy team a contact request with a summary of what the person wants; a team member replies by email. The person receives no automatic email. Call it ONLY when the person gave their real name, a confirmed email address and explicit consent to be contacted. Optionally name the course slug

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_courses, get_course, list_events, list_certificates, list_trainers, list_topics, get_pricing_tiers, list_pages, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Private data: search_courses, get_pricing_tiers, list_pages, create_lead · Public sink: list_blog_posts, get_blog_post, create_lead · Destructive: search_courses, list_events.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_courses, get_course, list_events, list_certificates, list_trainers, list_topics, get_pricing_tiers, list_pages, list_blog_posts, get_blog_post · Private data: search_courses, get_pricing_tiers, list_pages, create_lead · Public sink: list_blog_posts, get_blog_post, create_lead · Destructive: search_courses, list_events

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
